verdict.rationale: Adyen In-Person Payments is a payments/POS platform, not an AI agent or assistant that would itself consume external MCP servers' tools. The evidence only shows Adyen publishing its own MCP server (docs-13, docs-20, probe-4) so external LLM clients can call Adyen's APIs — the reverse of this story's client-role axis, which does not apply to this product type.
